about.title: About Us
about.story: The story of the CPK platform is, above all, that of two technology enthusiasts, Melik Messaoudi and Edem Aifia. Noticing that communication between administration, parents, and students lacked a modern digital bridge, they decided to take matters into their own hands. Armed with their vision and lines of code, they built this space from scratch. Their goal? To prove that Tunisian youth can create professional, secure, tailor-made tools to modernize education.

privacy.title: Your data, privacy
privacy.intro: This page explains, simply, what information Collège Pilote du Kef collects through this platform, and why.
privacy.collected1: Identity: parent's first and last name, child's first name and class. Your national ID (CIN) is never asked for at sign-up — it's optional, and only stored if you choose to add it to your profile yourself.
privacy.collected2: Contact: phone number (it doubles as your login identifier) and email address if you provide one.
privacy.collected3: Schooling: class timetable, teacher absences, homework, and exam dates.
privacy.collected4: Content you publish: feed posts and comments, project-group messages, and ideas submitted to the suggestion box.
privacy.collected5: Photos: your profile picture and any media you publish on the feed.
privacy.collected6: History of messages sent by the platform (SMS and email): recipient, content and delivery status, for technical follow-up.
privacy.collected7: Notifications: a technical identifier for your device or browser, needed to deliver notifications, plus the date you were last active.
privacy.collected8: Donations: the amount and payment reference. The payment itself is handled by Flouci — no banking details ever pass through or are stored by the platform.
privacy.purpose: This data is used solely for the school's administrative and educational management (account validation, communication, timetable tracking, school life). It is never sold or shared with third parties.
privacy.ai: Questions you ask the assistant are sent to Google Gemini, the AI service that generates the answer. Please don't type sensitive or personal information there.
privacy.rights: You can view and correct your information at any time from your profile. To request deletion of your account and its data, contact the administration.
privacy.contact: Contact us at 99766801 or by email at contact@cpkef.tn.
